7. Full Service & Maintenance Contract (FSMC) Clause - The following FSMC clau se will form part of the contract placed on successful Bidder - 7.1. The FSMC shall be valid for a term of One Year from the date of place ment of GeM contract. 7.2. The FSMC does not cover any free upgrade of operating system, appli cation software, RDBMS and antivirus software, if any loaded in the machi nes and it is not in the scope of this contract. The FSMC also not covers m aintenance of UPS installed along with photocopiers. 7.3. The Contract covers the repair and replacement of all defective items including consumables other than breakage. However if breakage happen s during the repair of machine by service engineer, such breakage will be covered under FSMC and cost will be borne by the service provider only. 7.4. Keeping in view the sensitiveness of the offices visiting by the Engine ers, the company should sensitize and educate the Engineers on the cond uct during the period of stay in the offices. 7.5. The entry of service engineer in Air HQ (VB), Air HQ (RKP), Air HQ (AB) & KG Marg are subject to the security rules laid down by Secu rity Office KG Marg, MoD. Police verification to be done and get a vendor pass issued by Security Office, Defence Complex, KG Marg, MoD to enter i nside the Air HQs building. 7.6. Manpower required: Two service Engineer 8. System Maintenance. The service provider will provide service / repair for all Models of the Machines mentioned in the Schedule of Requirement for one year. In order to ensure the serviceability of the machines during the contractual peri od. The service provider would provide system maintenance, which would inclu de periodic hardware maintenance. The service provider will also ensure that th e system continues to perform in exactly the same manner or better as at the ti me of acceptance. The QRs required by the user are enumerated below. 8.1. The vendor will maintain a 02 working days response time. 8.2. The vendor will submit user satisfaction report of the user directorate

s. 8.3. The service / repair will be carried out in response to the notice includ ing telephone, fax, email or letter and the call will be attended by the serv ice provider within two days. 8.4. In case any parts become ‘not repairable’, the service provider will re place such defective parts at free of cost. The replacement will be made w ith new parts or equivalent working spare. The defective parts, except H ard Disk, will become the property of the service provider. 8.5. The repairs will be done onsite and will need user’s approval if equip ment’s need to be moved out of site for repairs. 8.6. During FSMC machine can be downgraded to BER by vendor, only if machine complete its life of seven year. Before seven years machine can be downgraded only at the option of user. 8.7. If vendor fails to rectify the fault in any machine within thirty days, ve ndor will provide the standby machine of similar specification till the com pletion of FSMC period or main machine becomes serviceable. 9. Mandatory documents: Following documents are mandatory to be submitted by participating OEM / Authorized vendors while bidding on the GeM portal: 9.1. Bid specific ink signed authorization from the OEM. 9.2 Acceptance to all the terms and conditions of this specification docum ent. Note: Lacking of any of the above mentioned documents may lead to disq ualification of the participating firms / vendors. 10. To avoid unserviceability penalty the service provider may provide replacement for unserviceable machine till the rectification.
